items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: You can't play 'Leroy Brown' -- now, I'm going far back, you can see how far back I'm reaching, when I mention Leroy Brown

ctx.x: It's not going out all the time. So for that reason, the jazz man has an uphill battle to fight, because what kind of music is that? You can't play 'Leroy Brown' -- now, I'm going

far back, you can see how far back I'm reaching, when I mention Leroy Brown, which is not a bad -- but they're doing things that we're not into. We got rock, hard rock, bubble gum rock. It's gone out of our reach. And we're not against it, we're up against it. If they could just hear what we have, and then make a choice.
In summary, if you had it to do all over again, --
